categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the precision cleaning services sector for semiconductor and display panel equipment. Its main business includes semiconductor equipment cleaning, TFT and OLED display panel equipment cleaning, ceramic coating and anodizing services, and semiconductor equipment repair and refurbishment. It also provides value-added services such as testing and analysis, and manufacturing of semiconductor new parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced physical and chemical cleaning technologies tailored for high-precision semiconductor and display panel manufacturing equipment. It has developed proprietary cleaning processes for various equipment components, including PVD, CVD, etching, and ion implantation devices. The company also employs ceramic sputtering and anodizing technologies for equipment protection and refurbishment, supported by a comprehensive R&D center integrating cleaning, coating, and analytical technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major semiconductor foundries such as SMIC, TSMC, Intel, and display panel manufacturers like BOE, CSOT, and Tianma. The company serves the semiconductor wafer fabrication and packaging sectors, as well as TFT-LCD and OLED display panel production lines. It also collaborates with leading global semiconductor equipment suppliers including Lam Research, Applied Materials, and Tokyo Electron.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations are primarily concentrated in mainland China, covering major semiconductor and display manufacturing hubs such as Shanghai, Tianjin, Guangzhou, Dalian, and Anhui. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Japan and has established production and R&D centers in multiple Chinese cities. The company is expanding its footprint with new facilities planned in Qingdao and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the semiconductor and display panel supply chain, providing precision cleaning and maintenance services for manufacturing equipment. It also extends into downstream value-added services such as equipment repair, refurbishment, and component manufacturing, positioning itself as an integrated service provider within the equipment maintenance ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on technological innovation in precision cleaning and related value-added services, aiming to maintain leadership in the domestic market. R&D efforts emphasize developing new cleaning processes, improving cleaning efficiency and quality, and expanding into new application areas such as semiconductor materials and micro-contamination detection. The company invests heavily in talent acquisition and collaborates with academic institutions to enhance its innovation capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service contracts for precision cleaning of semiconductor and display panel equipment, including periodic maintenance and customized cleaning solutions. Additional income streams come from value-added services such as equipment repair, ceramic coating, anodizing, and testing services. The company mainly uses a direct sales model with some distribution channels, and revenue is recognized upon completion and customer acceptance of services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the earliest and leading precision cleaning service providers in China's semiconductor and display panel equipment sector. It holds a strong market position with advanced technology and comprehensive service offerings. Domestic competitors include Huzhou Kebing Electronics, Nanjing Hongjie Semiconductor, Suzhou Gaoxin Zhongke Semiconductor, and Jiangsu Kaiweite Semiconductor. The company leverages its first-mover advantage and extensive customer base to maintain competitive strength.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 780 million, representing a 28.12% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 109 million, up 15.95%. Total assets reached RMB 1.81 billion with shareholders' equity of RMB 1.51 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profitability, and R&D investment, with a growing workforce of over 1,600 employees and increasing market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive, one-stop precision cleaning and value-added service solutions tailored for semiconductor and display panel manufacturing equipment. It differentiates itself through advanced proprietary cleaning technologies, extensive service coverage across multiple equipment types and generations, and strong R&D capabilities. Close collaboration with leading customers and equipment suppliers enables customized, high-quality services that improve production yield and reduce costs, reinforcing its market leadership.
